post.summary: Put a form away. It stops taking answers and leaves the list; the answers it already has stay.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires forms.manage. Emits form.archived.

post.summary: Take a form back out of the archive. It comes back closed, not taking answers.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires forms.manage. Emits form.restored.

post.summary: Save wording to reuse: a name, whether it is a text or an email, and the words, with the same {{placeholders}} a workflow uses.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires templates.manage. Emits template.created.

post.summary: Change a saved piece of wording: its name, its words, or which folder it sits in.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires templates.manage. Emits template.updated.

post.summary: Put a piece of wording away, or bring it back. Nothing is deleted.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires templates.manage. Emits template.archived.

post.summary: Somebody reached for a template. Counted so the picker puts what this business actually says at the top.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires inbox.use. Emits .

post.summary: Start connecting a Google Business Profile or a Facebook Page, so the reviews people leave show here and can be answered from here. Returns a one-time state; the browser signs in through the worker.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires reviews.manage. Emits review_connection.connect_started.

post.summary: Stop reading reviews from this place. HandsFreeOS forgets the sign-in; the reviews already here stay, and so does every one of them on Google or Facebook.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires reviews.manage. Emits review_connection.disconnected.

post.summary: Ask this place for new reviews now, instead of waiting for the next hourly read.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires reviews.manage. Emits review_connection.sync_requested.

post.summary: Answer a review where people will read it. The words are kept here first and posted after, so a provider having a bad morning delays the answer rather than losing it.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires reviews.manage. Emits review.replied.

post.summary: Fill in a form for a customer yourself and send it, in one go. Works with no signal; the phone keeps it until there is some.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.write. Emits form.submitted, person.created, lead.created, task.created, invoice.created, workflow.enrol_requested. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Delete one response: a test of your own, or a customer asking to be forgotten. The answers go with it.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires forms.manage. Emits form.response_deleted.

post.summary: Begin moving a number the business already owns to HandsFreeOS.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits number_port.started.

post.summary: Put in what the old carrier needs: the account number, the PIN, who is authorising it.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits number_port.saved.

post.summary: Reserve a place for the signed authorisation or a recent bill (10 MB at most). Upload it to the returned path, then confirm it with file.confirm and attach it.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires channels.manage. Emits .

post.summary: Record that a signed authorisation or a recent bill has been uploaded for a port.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires channels.manage. Emits number_port.document_attached.

post.summary: Send the port to the carrier. A full port moves calls too, and takes two to four weeks.
post.description: Risk level 4. Requires channels.manage. Emits number_port.submitted, migration.task_changed.

post.summary: Call off a port. The carrier may already have moved it, in which case it is too late.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires channels.manage. Emits number_port.cancelled, migration.task_changed.

post.summary: Start bringing a number that is already in Twilio — the business’s own Twilio account, or GoHighLevel / LeadConnector — into this business. The number keeps its public number; HandsFreeOS sets it up the moment it arrives.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits number_import.started, migration.task_changed.

post.summary: Stop watching for a number to arrive. Nothing changes where the number is today; ask for the transfer to be called off too if it was requested.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits number_import.cancelled, migration.task_changed.

post.summary: Look for a number that is on its way here right now, rather than at the next check.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires channels.manage. Emits number_import.check_requested.

post.summary: Turn on phone & texting: HandsFreeOS makes this business its own Twilio account now, and shows its Account SID — what HighLevel or Twilio asks for to move a number here.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires channels.manage. Emits telephony.enable_requested.

post.summary: Turn off phone & texting: closes this business’s Twilio account for good. Only when no number, transfer, port, RCS sender or texting registration is in it; turning it on again gives a new Account SID.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires channels.manage. Emits telephony.disable_requested.

post.summary: Choose whether everyone in the business sees every conversation, or each person sees only the ones assigned to them and the ones on the numbers they answer.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires channels.manage. Emits inbox.visibility_changed.

post.summary: Put the business’s forms, payment links, estimates, invoices and booking page on a domain it owns. HandsFreeOS shows the DNS records to add and checks them.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits branded_domain.added.

post.summary: Check the domain’s DNS records now, rather than waiting for the daily check.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires channels.manage. Emits branded_domain.check_requested.

post.summary: Take the business off its own domain. Its forms, payment links, estimates, invoices and booking page go back to handsfreeos.com at once; links already sent on the old domain stop working.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires channels.manage. Emits branded_domain.removed.

post.summary: Make a field for customers, companies, leads or one kind of record (a pet’s breed, a car’s plate). Its key is made from its name.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires fields.manage. Emits custom_field.created.

post.summary: Rename a field, change its choices, its help line or where it sits, or whether it shows when empty. Its type stays.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires fields.manage. Emits custom_field.updated.

post.summary: Retire a field. Its answers come off every record that has one (0076), so this is for a field nobody fills in any more.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires fields.manage. Emits custom_field.archived.

post.summary: Fill in or clear the fields a business invented on a customer, company, lead or record: only the ones edited, each checked against its field, and the newest change to each wins.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits person.updated, company.updated, lead.updated, custom_record.updated.

post.summary: Make a kind of record the business keeps (pets, vehicles, properties), with its first fields and the relationship that ties it to customers.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires fields.manage. Emits custom_record_type.created.

post.summary: Rename a kind of record, change its picture, what its name is called, or where it sits.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires fields.manage. Emits custom_record_type.updated.

post.summary: Archive a kind of record: its tab, its records and its relationships are hidden, and nothing is deleted. Restoring brings them all back.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires fields.manage. Emits custom_record_type.archived.

post.summary: Bring an archived kind of record back, with the relationships archived along with it.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires fields.manage. Emits custom_record_type.restored.

post.summary: Add a record of one of the business’s own kinds (a pet, a vehicle, a property), with its fields, and relate it to a customer as it is made.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits custom_record.created.

post.summary: Change a record’s name or notes: only what was edited, each with what the editor saw, and the newest change to each wins.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits custom_record.updated.

post.summary: Archive a record: hidden from lists and searches, its history, tasks, files and relationships kept.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires records.archive. Emits custom_record.archived.

post.summary: Restore an archived record.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.archive. Emits custom_record.restored.

post.summary: Put someone on a record kept to its people (a deal): they see it and everything about it. With main, they become its main person (owners and admins only); the one they replace stays on it.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.write. Emits custom_record.team_changed.

post.summary: Take someone off a record kept to its people. Its main person can only be taken off by an owner or admin, and the next person on it becomes the main one.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.write. Emits custom_record.team_changed.

post.summary: Put a record on legal hold, with a reason: its files and history stay exactly as they are until the hold is lifted. New ones can still be added. Owners and admins.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.hold. Emits record_hold.placed.

post.summary: Lift a legal hold, with a reason kept on the record: its files and history can be changed and deleted again. Owners and admins.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires records.hold. Emits record_hold.lifted.

post.summary: Delete customers for good, with everything only about them: they wait 30 days in the Deleted bin first. Their bills stay, with just their name.
post.description: Risk level 4. Requires records.delete. Emits person.deleted, appointment.cancelled, attendee.removed, waitlist.seat_freed.

post.summary: Delete conversations for good, with their messages and calls: they wait 30 days in the Deleted bin first. The customer stays.
post.description: Risk level 4. Requires records.delete. Emits conversation.deleted.

post.summary: Delete a booking for good: one still to come is cancelled first, telling the customers if asked. It waits 30 days in the Deleted bin.
post.description: Risk level 4. Requires records.delete. Emits appointment.deleted, appointment.cancelled.

post.summary: Delete leads for good, with their tasks and files: they wait 30 days in the Deleted bin first. Their customer stays, with their conversations, bookings and bills.
post.description: Risk level 4. Requires records.delete. Emits lead.deleted.

post.summary: Delete companies for good, with their notes, tasks, files, relationships and the leads only theirs: they wait 30 days in the Deleted bin first. Their people stay.
post.description: Risk level 4. Requires records.delete. Emits company.deleted.

post.summary: Delete records of the business’s own kinds for good, with their notes, tasks, files and relationships: they wait 30 days in the Deleted bin first. An add-on’s records can only be archived.
post.description: Risk level 4. Requires records.delete. Emits custom_record.deleted.

post.summary: Bring something back from the Deleted bin, as it was. A conversation whose line has had a new one since joins it.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.delete. Emits bin.restored.

post.summary: Delete now what’s in the Deleted bin, or all of it, rather than waiting the 30 days. It can’t be brought back after.
post.description: Risk level 4. Requires records.delete. Emits bin.emptied.

post.summary: Check in somewhere you’re alone, with when you plan to leave. If you don’t check out, HandsFreeOS asks you, then tells your safety contacts where you were.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workspace.read. Emits safety.checked_in, safety.checked_out. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Where your phone is now, while you’re checked in and sharing it. Only the latest spot is kept, for your contacts if they’re told.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires workspace.read. Emits . Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Add time to your check-in. Answering “Still there?” this way also tells HandsFreeOS you’re OK.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workspace.read. Emits safety.extended. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Check out: you’ve left. If anyone was told, they hear you’re OK.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workspace.read. Emits safety.checked_out. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Ask for help now: your safety contacts are told at once where you are. HandsFreeOS never calls 911; call them yourself if you’re in danger.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires workspace.read. Emits safety.help.

post.summary: Say you reached the teammate who didn’t check out and they’re OK: the alerts stop for everyone. Only someone they asked to be told can.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workspace.read. Emits safety.resolved.

post.summary: Add or change someone to tell if you miss a check-out: a teammate, or someone outside by phone and email. Someone outside is asked to agree by text first.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workspace.read. Emits safety_contact.saved.

post.summary: Stop telling someone when you miss a check-out.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workspace.read. Emits safety_contact.removed.

post.summary: Settings → Safety: how long after a planned end the person is asked, how long before their contacts are told, and who’s told when someone has no contacts.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires workspace.update. Emits safety.settings_saved.

post.summary: Support: ask a business to let you see its private records (its deals) from your look at it, for 24 hours. Its owners and admins are emailed.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires platform.view_as. Emits support_access.requested.

post.summary: Let HandsFreeOS support see the private records you see (your deals), read-only, for 24 hours: answering their request, or unasked.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires records.read. Emits support_access.granted.

post.summary: Say no to HandsFreeOS support’s request to see this business’s private records.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.read. Emits support_access.declined.

post.summary: End HandsFreeOS support’s access to this business’s private records now.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.read. Emits support_access.ended.

post.summary: Say you’ve seen an alert an add-on raised (a late duty, a deal at risk), from its card on Home. The add-on stops raising it higher; it goes when the work is done.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workspace.read. Emits addon_alert.acknowledged.

post.summary: Set up how two kinds of record relate (a customer and a pet, a parent and a student, spouses), what each end is called, and how many each may have. Many to many unless said.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires fields.manage. Emits relationship_type.created.

post.summary: Rename either end of a relationship type, change how many each end may have, or where it sits. Saying “one” is refused while a record already has more.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires fields.manage. Emits relationship_type.updated.

post.summary: Archive a relationship type: its pairs are hidden from every record, and nothing is deleted. Restoring brings them back.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires fields.manage. Emits relationship_type.archived.

post.summary: Bring an archived relationship type back, with its pairs.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires fields.manage. Emits relationship_type.restored.

post.summary: Relate two records the way a relationship type says: a customer and their pet, a parent and a student, two spouses. Refused where an end may have only one and already does.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits relationship.created.

post.summary: Change the note on a pair ("Primary driver", "Lease ends in August").
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits relationship.updated.

post.summary: Take a pair apart. Neither record is touched, and both timelines say who did it.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.write. Emits relationship.deleted.

post.summary: Share an idea for HandsFreeOS. It starts under review with your vote on it, and you hear when it moves.
post.description: Risk level 1. Emits platform.idea_shared.

post.summary: Change an idea’s title, details or area: its author, until the team has answered it, or the team.
post.description: Risk level 1. Emits platform.idea_edited.

post.summary: Vote for an idea. You hear when it moves along the roadmap.
post.description: Risk level 0. Emits platform.idea_voted.

post.summary: Take your vote back from an idea.
post.description: Risk level 0. Emits platform.idea_unvoted.

post.summary: Hear by email when an idea moves along the roadmap, or stop hearing about it. Sharing, voting and commenting follow an idea on their own.
post.description: Risk level 0. Emits platform.idea_followed.

post.summary: Comment on an idea. From the HandsFreeOS team, it is shown as the team’s answer and its author hears about it.
post.description: Risk level 1. Emits platform.idea_commented.

post.summary: Take a comment down (your own, or any as the team), or put one back (the team only).
post.description: Risk level 1. Emits platform.idea_comment_hidden.

post.summary: Note that you have read What’s new, so nothing in it shows as new to you.
post.description: Risk level 0. Emits .

post.summary: Move an idea along the roadmap, with a note for the people following it, who are emailed unless you say not to.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires platform.ideas.manage. Emits platform.idea_status_changed.

post.summary: Fold a duplicate into the idea it repeats. Its votes and followers go with it, and its followers are told where.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires platform.ideas.moderate. Emits platform.idea_merged.

post.summary: Take an idea off the board (spam, or not an idea at all), or put it back. Its author still sees it.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires platform.ideas.moderate. Emits platform.idea_hidden.

post.summary: Add a part of HandsFreeOS ideas can be about, rename one, reorder it, or archive it (its ideas keep it).
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires platform.ideas.manage. Emits platform.idea_area_saved.

post.summary: Write or change an entry in What’s new, and say which ideas it delivers. It stays a draft until published.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires platform.ideas.manage. Emits platform.whats_new_saved.

post.summary: Publish an entry in What’s new. The ideas it delivers become Done, and the people following them are emailed.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires platform.ideas.manage. Emits platform.whats_new_published, platform.idea_status_changed.

post.summary: Take an entry out of What’s new and back to a draft. Ideas it marked Done stay Done.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires platform.ideas.manage. Emits platform.whats_new_unpublished.

post.summary: Delete a draft in What’s new. A published entry is unpublished first.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires platform.ideas.manage. Emits platform.whats_new_deleted.

post.summary: Connect the RCS sender made for this business at Twilio, by its id. Once the carriers approve it, texts go as RCS where the customer’s phone can show it and as SMS or MMS where it can’t.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits rcs_sender.connect_requested.

post.summary: Switch RCS off or back on (off sends every text as SMS or MMS and keeps the sender), or choose the number a customer’s first RCS message starts its thread on.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits rcs_sender.updated.

post.summary: Ask Twilio where the RCS sender stands now, instead of waiting for the next check: after the carriers approve it, or after fixing something in the Twilio console.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires channels.manage. Emits rcs_sender.refresh_requested.

post.summary: Let the RCS sender go: it comes off the business’s messaging service and every text goes as SMS or MMS again. The sender itself stays at Twilio.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits rcs_sender.disconnect_requested.

post.summary: Ask HandsFreeOS to make this business’s RCS sender, and start paying for it: $800 for the first year (Carrier onboarding $500, passed on at cost; Brand vetting by Aegis $200, passed on at cost; Setup by HandsFreeOS $100), then $215 a year. The worker makes the Stripe page; read its address from phone.setup_status. Asking again while one is waiting to be paid picks that one back up.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires channels.manage. Emits rcs_request.submitted.

post.summary: Give up on an RCS request that hasn’t been paid, or stop a paid one renewing: RCS stays on until the year paid for ends, nothing more is charged, and support is told so they can take the sender down then.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits rcs_request.cancelled, rcs_request.stopped, support_ticket.opened.

post.summary: Pay RCS’s yearly renewal with another card, after the card on file refused it. The worker makes the Stripe page; read its address from phone.setup_status (rcsRequest.renewalCheckoutUrl). The new card is the one charged from then on.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires channels.manage. Emits rcs_request.renewal_page_requested.

post.summary: Pay a texting fee on a Stripe page with another card: a registration’s fees the card said no to, or a month of the campaign. The worker makes the page; read its address from phone.setup_status (textingFees). The card paid with is the one charged from then on.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires channels.manage. Emits texting_fee.page_requested.

post.summary: Start connecting the business’s Facebook Pages and Instagram accounts, so their direct messages arrive in the inbox and can be answered from it. Returns a one-time state; the browser signs in to Facebook through the worker.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits meta_connection.connect_started.

post.summary: Disconnect Facebook: HandsFreeOS forgets the sign-in and stops answering every Page and Instagram account it connected. Conversations and their messages stay; nothing changes on Facebook or Instagram.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits meta_connection.disconnected, meta_account.disconnected, meta_account.needs_attention.

post.summary: Stop answering one Facebook Page or Instagram account here. Its conversations and messages stay, and connecting it again picks them up where they were.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits meta_account.disconnected.

post.summary: Install an add-on in this business (and, with `include`, what it needs). It turns on once the worker has set it up.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires addons.manage. Emits addon.install_started, addon.enabled.

post.summary: Turn an installed add-on back on, with its data and settings as they were.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires addons.manage. Emits addon.enabled, addon.install_started.

post.summary: Turn an add-on off: it stops, its screens and records are hidden, and its data and settings are kept.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires addons.manage. Emits addon.disabled.

post.summary: Uninstall an add-on: it stops and lets go of what it holds outside HandsFreeOS; its data is kept until an owner deletes it.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires addons.manage. Emits addon.disabled, addon.uninstall_started.

post.summary: Permanently delete an uninstalled add-on’s data. Core records it touched stay; history keeps its lines without the details.
post.description: Risk level 4. Requires addons.purge. Emits addon.purge_started.

post.summary: Start an installed add-on fresh: permanently delete all of its data and install it again, empty, in one step. Core records it touched stay; history keeps its lines without the details.
post.description: Risk level 4. Requires addons.purge. Emits addon.uninstall_started.

post.summary: Save an add-on’s settings and switches for this business.
post.description: Risk level 2. Emits addon.settings_saved.

post.summary: Save your own settings for an add-on.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workspace.read. Emits .

post.summary: Set aside an add-on Home suggested: not now (no suggestions for a while), or not interested in this one again.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires workspace.read. Emits .

post.summary: Vote for a planned add-on for this business: one vote per business on each add-on it wants. Every Sunday at midnight Eastern, the one with the most votes becomes Coming soon.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires addons.manage. Emits addon.voted.

post.summary: Take back this business’s vote for a planned add-on.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires addons.manage. Emits addon.unvoted.

post.summary: Set aside Home’s note that an add-on this business voted for is coming soon, or ready to add.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires workspace.read. Emits .

post.summary: Choose what comes next for a week that closed with nothing voted for or a tie: it becomes Coming soon, and the businesses that voted for it are told.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires platform.addons.manage. Emits platform.addon_picked.

post.summary: Staff: let one business install an add-on that is still being built, to try it. Its owners and admins add it from their Add-ons page.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires platform.addons.manage. Emits addon_grant.given.

post.summary: Staff: stop offering a business an add-on it was handed to try. If it already added it, it keeps running.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires platform.addons.manage. Emits addon_grant.taken_back.

post.summary: Let go of an add-on’s account at another service. Its key or sign-in is wiped at once; the add-on uses HandsFreeOS’s own account there, if it has one, or nothing.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires workspace.read. Emits addon_connection.disconnected.

post.summary: Staff: turn HandsFreeOS’s own account at a service on or off for one business’s add-on. A business that connects its own account uses that instead.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires platform.addons.manage. Emits addon_connection.platform_changed.

post.summary: Save the four quick questions after Create business: what the business wants help with first, where its customers are now, its website, and how many people work there. They put the setup steps in order.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workspace.update. Emits onboarding.answers_saved.

post.summary: Skip a Getting started step for now, or bring a skipped one back. A step for the whole business needs workspace.update; a step on your own list (the phone app, signing in faster, notifications, your calendar) is yours to skip.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workspace.read. Emits onboarding.step_skipped.

post.summary: Answer the customers step with "Add them as you go": new leads add themselves, so the step counts as done. False takes the answer back.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workspace.update. Emits onboarding.customers_as_you_go.

post.summary: Hide your Getting started guide from Home, or show it again from Get help; or record that you finished or skipped the tour. Your own view only.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires workspace.read. Emits onboarding.view_changed.

post.summary: Finish your Getting started guide for good, once every step on your list is done, waiting on someone else, or skipped. It doesn’t come back after, even if something is disconnected later. Refused while a step is still to do.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires workspace.read. Emits onboarding.finished.

post.summary: Email yourself a link to a Getting started step that’s easier on a computer ("Email me a link" in the phone app). The same step again within 10 minutes isn’t sent twice.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires workspace.read. Emits onboarding.link_requested.

post.summary: Turn Getting started off for everyone in this business, or back on (Settings → Workspace). Off, nobody sees the guide on Home, the setup wizard or the tour; each person’s own progress is kept for when it’s turned on again.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workspace.update. Emits onboarding.enabled_changed.

post.summary: For an agency: email a client business’s owners a reminder with their next Getting started step. One a day per business, whoever in the agency asks.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires org.templates.manage. Emits onboarding.remind_requested.

post.summary: Keep the onboarding setup’s answers while someone is part way through, so they can carry on later or from the phone, and save what can’t wait: the first screen saves the business’s name, kind, address, time zone and website (and the AI teammate starts reading the website), and picks where the answers start from (answers the business’s agency saved, or our picks); “How many people work with you?” sends invitations; the goal and where customers are put Home’s list in order; the simple page (for a business with no website) goes live with its open hours and business profile, or is turned off; the booking stop makes the booking page and turns it on (left to the owner when someone from their agency sets it up); and the review link is saved for thank-you texts.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires workspace.update. Emits onboarding_setup.started, ai_setup.read_requested, look.find_requested.

post.summary: Save everything the onboarding setup kept, on “Stay in the loop”: the AI quick setup’s own Save (open hours, the business profile, quick facts, a website chat and the AI teammate, which stays off), services with a price on the price list, and your own hours from the open hours. Someone from the business’s agency who isn’t on its team hands it to the owner instead: everything but their own hours is saved, and the owner is invited by email to check it and finish. Refuses answers that started from older AI teammate settings (revision_conflict).
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires workspace.update. Emits onboarding_setup.finished, onboarding_setup.handed_over.

post.summary: Reserve a place to upload a picture of the business’s logo (PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF or SVG, up to 5 MB). Upload it there, then hand it over with look.use_upload.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workspace.update. Emits .

post.summary: Hand the uploaded picture of the logo to HandsFreeOS, which makes it ready for the booking page, chat, invoices and emails, and picks its colour unless one was picked.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workspace.update. Emits look.upload_ready.

post.summary: Change the business’s colour, or take its logo off so its initials stand in. The website chat follows the colour unless it has one of its own.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workspace.update. Emits look.changed.

post.summary: Look on the business’s website for its logo, and the colour it stands for. A logo found there never replaces one already kept.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workspace.update. Emits look.find_requested.

post.summary: Start a buyer deal or a listing: kept to the people on it, with its client, property and Pipeline lead, and the duties of the stage it starts in and every stage before it.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.deal.opened.

post.summary: Move a deal forward to a later stage. Every stage it passes gets its duties too. It moves back only through what happened (an offer lost, a contract terminated, a listing back on the market).
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.deal.stage_changed.

post.summary: Record something that happened on a deal (an offer came in, the inspection report is in, a repair request, repairs agreed, a low appraisal, an amendment, a changed search), which brings its duties.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.deal.event_recorded.

post.summary: A buyer’s offer was turned down or withdrawn: the deal goes back to Touring, the offer’s terms and unfinished duties are set aside (kept in history), and the next steps are added.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.deal.offer_lost.

post.summary: A contract fell through: a buyer deal goes back to Searching and a listing back to Active, the contract’s terms and unfinished duties are set aside (kept in history), and the steps that follow a termination are added.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.deal.terminated.

post.summary: Mark a deal at Closing closed: a buyer deal moves to Possession and a listing to Sold, the after-closing duties are added, and its Pipeline lead can be marked won too.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.deal.closed.

post.summary: End a deal that won’t close: a listing withdrawn, expired or cancelled, or a buyer who stopped looking or went elsewhere. Its unfinished duties are cancelled with the reason; it can be reopened.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.deal.ended.

post.summary: Reopen a deal that ended: a listing goes back on the market (Active) and a buyer deal back to work where it was, each with its stage’s duties again.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.deal.reopened.

post.summary: Say what’s true of a deal or its home (financed, an HOA, a well, septic, solar, open houses, a backup offer…). Duties a fact brings are added; ones that no longer apply and haven’t been started are cancelled.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.deal.facts_changed.

post.summary: Put someone from the team on a deal as co-agent, coordinator or assistant: they see it and everything about it. The deal’s main agent does this, and so do owners and admins.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.deal.team_changed.

post.summary: Take someone off a deal. Their unfinished duties go to whoever their role now falls to. Only owners and admins take off the main agent; the next person on it becomes the main one.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.deal.team_changed.

post.summary: Change what someone on a deal does there: co-agent, coordinator or assistant, or make them its main agent (owners and admins only; the one they replace stays on as co-agent). Duties follow the role.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.deal.team_changed.

post.summary: Say which home a deal is about: one already here, or a new one by its address. A deal has one property; a property keeps every deal done on it.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.deal.property_set.

post.summary: Link a buyer deal and a listing: the two sides of one home (they share its property), or a client’s sale and their next purchase (whose dates are then checked against each other).
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.deal.linked, realestate.duty.evidence_added.

post.summary: Undo a link between two deals. Both keep their property, dates and duties.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.deal.unlinked.

post.summary: Tie one of the business’s customers or companies to a deal in a role: client, loan officer, other side’s agent, title contact, inspector, vendor, attorney, lender, title company or brokerage.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.party.added.

post.summary: Untie a customer or company from a deal. They stay one of the business’s contacts, with every other deal they’re on.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.party.removed.

post.summary: Set what was agreed for a deal’s commission: a rate of the price or a flat amount, any credit back to the client, and the agent’s split. The expected amount follows the price.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.deal.commission_set.

post.summary: Set what a closed deal’s commission came to in the end. Owners and admins (Approve exceptions) only.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.except. Emits realestate.deal.final_commission_set.

post.summary: Archive a deal: out of the lists, with its history, duties, documents and dates kept. Deals are never deleted. Owners and admins.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires realestate.use. Emits .

post.summary: Bring an archived deal back, as it was. Owners and admins.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits .

post.summary: Enter a deal’s key date or term (acceptance, inspection period, closing, price, earnest money…) with where it came from. Saved by a person it’s confirmed unless they say not. An amendment or correction names the entry it replaces; a value that disagrees with one already there waits for a person to choose.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.term.entered.

post.summary: Confirm a key date or term someone entered without confirming it. Duties resting on a date it confirms become ready to work.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.term.confirmed.

post.summary: Set aside a key date or term that was entered but never confirmed, with why. It stays in the history. A confirmed one is replaced by entering a correction instead.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.term.rejected.

post.summary: Settle a key date or term whose entries disagree: the one kept counts (confirmed), and the others are set aside, kept in the history with the reason.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.term.conflict_resolved.

post.summary: Say where a duty stands: not started, in progress, waiting on someone (who), or blocked (by what, whose it is to clear, what it holds up, when to look again). Its due date never moves for it.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.duty.status_changed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Add proof to a duty: one of the deal’s documents or files, a note, the person’s own word (an attestation), an appointment or a message. Answers what’s still missing.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.duty.evidence_added. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Take back proof added to a duty by mistake, with why. It stays in the duty’s history and no longer counts.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Give a duty to someone on its deal to answer for, or to nobody by name (the brokerage). Only someone on the deal can have one.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.duty.assigned.

post.summary: Say you’ve seen that a duty is at risk. The alert stops asking; the duty still needs doing.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.duty.acknowledged. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Mark a duty done. Refused until it has the proof its rule asks for, saying what’s missing; an owner or admin can mark it done without it, with a reason.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.duty.completed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Mark a duty done without the proof its rule asks for, with the reason. Owners and admins (Approve exceptions) only; kept in its history.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.except. Emits realestate.duty.completed.

post.summary: Waive a duty that isn’t needed on this deal, with the reason. Owners and admins (Approve exceptions) only.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.except. Emits realestate.duty.waived.

post.summary: Cancel a duty that no longer applies (a stage the deal skipped, a step that won’t happen), with the reason.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.duty.cancelled.

post.summary: Put a finished duty back to work, with why: a done one goes back in progress, a waived or cancelled one to not started.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.duty.reopened.

post.summary: Set when a duty is due by hand, with why, or clear it so its rule decides again. A date with no time is due at 11:59 pm where the business is.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.duty.due_set.

post.summary: Write a duty on one deal that its list doesn’t have: its name, who answers for it, how much it matters, what proof finishes it, and when it’s due.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.duty.added.

post.summary: Someone said a deal’s wiring instructions changed: a critical alert at once, and a hold that ends only when a person checks by phone at a number they found themselves. Nothing relays the new instructions.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.deal.wire_change_reported.

post.summary: Make one of a deal’s files one of its documents: its kind (purchase contract, amendment, inspection report…), its title, and the document it’s a newer version of.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.document.added, realestate.contract.read_requested. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Rename a deal’s document, change its kind while it’s a draft, or say it was sent for signing.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.document.updated.

post.summary: Mark a deal’s document signed: its file is locked for good (never deleted or renamed), earlier versions are replaced, and it becomes the one that counts of its kind unless another does.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.document.signed, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: Say which document of its kind counts on a deal (the controlling contract, say), when it isn’t the newest signed one.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.document.controlling_set.

post.summary: Void a deal’s document with the reason (a released contract, a form sent in error). It stays on the deal, signed and locked if it was, and no longer counts.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.document.voided.

post.summary: Change one of the list’s duties for this business: turn it off or on, or change when it’s due, its reminders, who answers for it, what finishes it, or how much it matters. A draft until published.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.manage. Emits realestate.template.changed.

post.summary: Put one of the list’s duties back as the catalog has it. A draft until published.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.manage. Emits realestate.template.changed.

post.summary: Write one of the business’s own duties, or change one: what brings it (a stage, a date confirmed, a moment), when it’s due, its proof, who answers for it and how much it matters. A draft until published.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.manage. Emits realestate.template.changed.

post.summary: Take one of the business’s own duties off the list. Deals that have it keep it; new ones won’t once published.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.manage. Emits realestate.template.changed.

post.summary: Publish the duty list as it’s drafted now: a new version that every new deal takes. Open deals keep theirs until someone applies it to them.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.manage. Emits realestate.template.published.

post.summary: Move an open deal to a version of the duty list (the newest unless said): duties it turns off are cancelled, changed ones take its timing and proof, and ones it adds for what already happened are created. Owners and admins.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.manage. Emits realestate.deal.template_applied.

post.summary: Ask for a status email to a deal’s client: HandsFreeOS drafts it from the deal’s facts (its stage, confirmed dates, what’s done and what’s next), checks it for fair-housing risk, and leaves it for the agent to edit and send.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.status_email.requested.

post.summary: Save the agent’s edits to a client update. Its words are checked again for fair-housing risk (the list at once, the model a moment later), and any earlier confirmation of flags no longer counts.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.status_email.saved. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Confirm a client update’s fair-housing flags are fine as written, with the reason. Kept with the update; editing it again asks again.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.status_email.flags_acknowledged.

post.summary: Send a client update the agent has reviewed, as an email to the deal’s client, from the agent’s own mailbox if they have one, else the team inbox. Refused while its fair-housing flags are neither fixed nor confirmed.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.status_email.sent. Can wait on a phone for 30 minutes, then asks.

post.summary: Throw away a client update that won’t be sent. It stays in the deal’s history.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.status_email.discarded.

post.summary: Save what a buyer wants: their price range, areas, kinds of home, bedrooms, baths, size, when they need to move, must-haves and deal-breakers. Each save is kept. Words about who lives in an area, rather than the home, are refused.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.buyer_profile.saved. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Add a home to a buyer deal: its address, a listing’s link (kept for people to open, never read) and, if there is one, the listing’s pasted words, which the AI reads for the home’s facts for the agent to confirm.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.home.added. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Confirm a home’s facts as the agent checked them against the listing. The AI suggests them; only a person confirms.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.home.facts_confirmed.

post.summary: Say where a home stands for the buyer: saved, shortlisted, toured, offer made, passed, or removed from the deal.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.home.status_changed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Remember something a buyer wants or said (“A fenced yard for the dog”, “Must close by June 30”) on their deal. A person’s is kept; the AI’s waits for a person to confirm.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.memory.added. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Confirm or reject something the AI suggested about a buyer (with the words fixed if need be), or retire something that’s no longer true. Only a person decides.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.memory.decided.

post.summary: Ask the AI to read what the buyer has said since it last looked, now, and suggest what to remember.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.memory.requested.

post.summary: Plan a tour of a buyer’s homes: one appointment on the calendar with the homes in order, the client invited. Needs a signed buyer agreement that covers the day, unless an owner or admin makes an exception with a reason.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.tour.planned, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: Change which homes a planned tour sees, and in what order.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.tour.stops_changed.

post.summary: Move a planned tour to another time, and its appointment with it. The buyer agreement must cover the new day too, unless an owner or admin already let this tour through.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.tour.rescheduled.

post.summary: Cancel a planned tour, and its appointment, telling the client if asked.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.tour.canceled, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: Mark a home on a tour seen or skipped, with a note for the team. Once every home is, the tour is done.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.tour.visited, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Keep what a client thought of a home they saw on a tour (loved it, maybe, not for us), as the agent heard it.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.tour.feedback_added, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Start a CMA for one of a buyer deal’s homes or a listing’s own home, with its facts as the deal has them; or another CMA from an earlier one’s comps.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.cma.started.

post.summary: Set the facts of the home a draft CMA is for: beds, baths, square feet, list price, year built.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.cma.changed.

post.summary: Add a comparable home to a draft CMA: its address, sold price and date (or asking price while pending or for sale), beds, baths, square feet and distance.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.cma.changed.

post.summary: Change a draft CMA’s comp: its facts, whether it’s used, and the agent’s adjustments, each with its reason.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.cma.changed.

post.summary: Take a comp off a draft CMA.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.cma.changed.

post.summary: Finalize a CMA: its range is kept as the comps give it now, and its comps stay as they are.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.cma.finalized, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: Reopen a final CMA that hasn’t been shared, to change its comps.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.cma.changed.

post.summary: Ask for the CMA’s summary to be drafted from its numbers, for the agent to check. Replaces the summary there is.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.cma.summary_requested.

post.summary: Save the agent’s own words for a CMA’s summary. They’re checked again for fair-housing risk (the list at once, the model a moment later), and any earlier confirmation of flags no longer counts.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.cma.summary_saved.

post.summary: Confirm a CMA summary’s fair-housing flags are fine as written, with the reason. Kept with the CMA; editing it again asks again.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.cma.flags_acknowledged.

post.summary: Share a final CMA with the deal’s client: its range and summary go in their portal as a one-page summary. Refused until its summary has been checked and any fair-housing flag is fixed or kept with a reason.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.cma.shared, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: Record an offer as it was sent: on a buyer deal, one we made on one of their homes; on a listing, one a buyer made on it. Its terms, who it’s with, and when it must be answered by. The contract itself is uploaded as one of the deal’s documents.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.offer.version_added, realestate.deal.event_recorded, realestate.deal.facts_changed, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: Record the next version of an open offer, as it was sent: the seller’s counter, or ours. Who answers next, and by when, follows it.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.offer.version_added, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: Say which of the deal’s uploaded documents an offer’s version is: the contract or counter as signed.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: Record how an offer was answered: accepted (its terms go to the deal’s key dates to confirm, and the deal moves to Under contract), declined, or passed with no answer. With no other offer out, a lost offer takes the deal back to Touring.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.offer.answered, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: Withdraw an open offer, with the reason. With no other offer out, the deal goes back to Touring.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.offer.answered, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: Put the newest version of an offer in the client’s portal as a one-page summary in plain words. The team’s notes never show.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.offer.shared.

post.summary: Set a deal’s lender, loan officer and loan: the buyer’s, on a buyer deal or a listing.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.financing.changed.

post.summary: Keep where a financing step stands: when it started or is expected, the amount (preapproval, appraisal), the locked rate, when it ends, and a note.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.financing.changed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Mark a financing step done, with its proof: the lender’s letter or email, or one of the deal’s documents. Only a person marks a step done.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.financing.step_done, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Take back a financing step marked done, with the reason. Kept in the deal’s history.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.financing.changed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Add an inspection on a deal: its kind, the inspector, when, and when the report is expected. On a listing, it’s the buyer’s inspection at the home.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.inspection.changed, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Change an inspection’s inspector, time, expected report date or note.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.inspection.changed, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Mark an inspection’s report in, with the uploaded report. The deal’s first report brings the duties that follow one.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.inspection.report_in, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: Cancel an inspection, with the reason. Its findings stay, but no longer count toward the request.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.inspection.changed.

post.summary: Add what an inspection found: what and where, how serious, the estimate, the client’s priority, what to ask for and its photos.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.inspection.changed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Change a finding: its words, how serious, the estimate, the client’s priority, what to ask for or its photos.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.inspection.changed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Take off a finding typed in by mistake.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.inspection.changed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Keep the repair request as it was sent to the seller: its words, what it asks for by finding, and when they must answer by.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.repair.sent, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: Keep the seller’s answer to the repair request: agreed, a counter, or refused, in their words. Agreed brings the duties that follow agreed repairs.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.repair.answered, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: On a listing, keep the buyers’ repair request as it came in: its words, any credit asked for, and when it must be answered by. It brings the duties for answering it.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.repair.received, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: Give a deal’s client something to do in their portal: upload a document (a preapproval letter, an ID), sign off on words, or do something; for one client or all of them.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.client_task.added. Can wait on a phone for 30 minutes, then asks.

post.summary: Take back a task given to the client, with the reason. It leaves their portal.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.client_task.changed.

post.summary: Mark a client’s part of a task done for them, with a note (an ID handed over at the office). A sign-off is the client’s own, in their portal.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.client_task.done, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: Paste the home’s old listing words: the AI reads only these for its facts, each with the words it came from, for the agent to confirm. Replaces what was pasted before.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.listing.pasted.

post.summary: Confirm a listing’s facts as the agent checked them, each saying where it came from: the seller’s questionnaire, the old listing, or typed. Only these go on the page and the flyer. The AI suggests; only a person confirms.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.listing.facts_confirmed, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: Ask the seller to tell us about their home in their portal: its beds, baths, size, year built, HOA and garage, what they’ve updated and what they love about it. Asked once; asking again gives the same task.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.client_task.added.

post.summary: Add one of the deal’s uploaded photos to the listing, at the end. It’s on the public page and the flyer unless it’s kept for the agent and the seller.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.listing.photos_changed, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Put a listing’s photos in order, with their captions, and say which the public page shows. Every photo is listed, in the order shown.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.listing.photos_changed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Take a photo off the listing. The file stays in the deal’s files; the page and the flyer stop showing it.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.listing.photos_changed.

post.summary: Ask the AI to draft a listing’s description from its confirmed facts, the agent’s notes and the seller’s own words, for the agent to check and edit. Replaces the one being worked on.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.listing.description_requested.

post.summary: Save the agent’s own words for a listing’s description as a new version. The fixed list reads them at once and the model a moment later; any flag kept on an earlier version doesn’t carry over.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.listing.description_saved.

post.summary: Keep a listing description’s fair housing flags as written, with the reason. Kept with that version; a new version asks again.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.listing.description_flags_kept.

post.summary: Send a listing’s description to the seller to sign off in their portal, with its exact words. Refused until both fair housing checks have read it and every flag is fixed or kept with a reason.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.listing.description_sent, realestate.client_task.added.

post.summary: Put a checked listing description in use without the seller’s sign-off in the portal, with the reason (“signed on paper at the office”). Owners and admins only; kept on the deal’s history.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.listing.description_signed, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: Mark a listing live on the MLS, with its MLS number and the day it went live, and the MLS page as proof if there is one. Until then nothing about it is shared outside the office. A listing before Active moves there.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.listing.live, realestate.deal.stage_changed, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: Put a listing’s public page up, under the business’s site: its confirmed facts, the photos marked for it, its signed-off description and its open houses. Refused before it’s live on the MLS.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.listing.page_changed, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: Take a listing’s public page down. Its address stays the same if it goes up again.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.listing.page_changed.

post.summary: Tell the business’s contacts about a live listing by email or text: a campaign with exact words from its signed-off description and a link to its page, to the tags or stages picked. It waits in Campaigns for someone to approve it.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.listing.campaign_started, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: Ask the AI for three social posts about a listing, from its confirmed facts, price, signed-off description and open houses, each read by both fair housing checks. Nothing is posted: the agent copies them once it’s live on the MLS.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.listing.posts_requested.

post.summary: Save the agent’s own words for one of a listing’s social posts. The fixed list reads them at once and the model a moment later.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.listing.post_saved.

post.summary: Plan an open house for a listing: it goes on the host’s calendar, the seller sees it in their portal, and its sign-in page opens an hour before it starts once the listing is live on the MLS.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.open_house.planned, realestate.deal.facts_changed, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: Cancel a planned open house: its appointment comes off the calendar and its sign-in page closes.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.open_house.cancelled, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: Mark an open house visitor followed up, with a note. When everyone is, the reminder clears; it’s proof for S-39.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.open_house.followed_up, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: A visitor signs in at an open house on the host’s phone, handed to them, as on the sign-in page. On their own, they become a customer with a lead for the host, their yes to texts kept; working with another agent, they’re only recorded.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.open_house.signed_in, person.created, lead.created, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Save the figures for a listing’s seller’s estimate: what’s owed on the mortgage, the listing fee, title and escrow, transfer tax and other costs. Each save is kept beside the estimates it made.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.net_sheet.saved, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Put a listing’s open offers in the seller’s portal side by side, each with what they’d take home (an estimate), as they are now.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.offers.shared, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: Ask the seller to sign off a new list price in their portal, with its exact words (“Change the list price of 418 Maple Ave from $409,000 to $399,000.”). The new price is used only once they sign.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.listing.price_proposed, realestate.client_task.added. Can wait on a phone for 30 minutes, then asks.

post.summary: Use a new list price without the seller’s sign-off in the portal, with the reason (“signed the change on paper”). Owners and admins only; kept on the deal’s history.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.listing.price_changed, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: Withdraw a price change still waiting on the seller, with why. Its sign-off task leaves their portal; the price stays as it is.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.listing.price_withdrawn.

post.summary: Add one of our listings suggested for a buyer to their homes, with its facts as the listing has them.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.home.added, realestate.suggestion.decided.

post.summary: Set aside one of our listings suggested for a buyer: it isn’t a fit, with why if you like.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.suggestion.decided.

post.summary: Have the AI read a deal’s contract, amendment or addendum (a PDF, scans too) for its parties, money, dates and contingencies, each with its clause. Nothing changes on the deal until a person confirms each value.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.contract.read_requested.

post.summary: Confirm values a reading found in a contract, amendment or addendum: each goes on the deal’s key dates as confirmed, with its clause and words, replacing what was there. Duties resting on a date start or move.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.contract.confirmed, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: Set aside a value a reading found that isn’t right, with why. Nothing on the deal changes; type the right value under Key dates.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.contract.value_rejected.

post.summary: Track a contingency on a deal: one of the usual kinds (inspection, financing, appraisal, the sale of the buyer’s home, HOA documents, title review), ending on its key date, or one the contract names, with its own end date.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.contingency.added. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Record how a contingency ended: satisfied, waived or expired, with the signed removal form from the deal’s documents. An owner or admin can record it without the form, with a reason. The client sees it in their portal.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.contingency.resolved, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Say a duty can’t be done before another on the same deal. Its drawer shows what it waits on and who has it, and the deal turns yellow when it’s due soon with that one still open.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.duty.linked.

post.summary: Take back that a duty waits on another, when a person said so. The built-in order of duties stays.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.duty.unlinked.

post.summary: Say you chased whoever a duty is waiting on outside. The next day to chase moves on two business days, or to the day given.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.duty.chased.

post.summary: Look a buyer’s home up on the business’s listing feed again, by its address or an MLS number: its facts, photos and where it stands on the MLS, for the agent to check.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.home.lookup_requested.

post.summary: Look the deal’s own listing up on the business’s listing feed, by its MLS number or address: what the MLS says of its facts, beside the seller’s and the old listing’s, and where it stands there.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.listing.lookup_requested.

post.summary: Ask the business’s listing feed for homes sold near a draft CMA’s home: they come in as comps from the MLS that don’t count until the agent ticks them.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.cma.comps_requested.

post.summary: Get one of a deal’s documents ready for signing in the brokerage’s DocuSign or Dotloop, with who signs it and in what order. The agent then opens it there, places the fields and sends it; nothing is sent to the signers yet.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.esign.requested.

post.summary: Say a document in Dotloop has been signed by everyone, so its signed copy is fetched from the loop and kept, locked. (DocuSign says so itself.)
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.esign.signed_reported.

post.summary: Stop a signing, with the reason: it’s voided at DocuSign (nobody can sign it any more) and marked voided here. A Dotloop loop is left for the agent to archive there.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.esign.voided.

post.summary: How showings work on a listing: whether its page takes requests, whether the seller says yes or it’s confirmed on its own, the seller’s open days and times, a showing’s length, the access instructions, and when they and the feedback link go.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits .

post.summary: Add a showing of a listing by hand (one booked by phone, say), confirmed: the buyer’s agent, the time, and how to reach them for the access instructions and feedback link.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.showing.decided. Can wait on a phone for 30 minutes, then asks.

post.summary: Answer a showing request for the seller (confirm or turn it down), or cancel a showing, with a note. The buyer’s agent hears.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.showing.decided. Can wait on a phone for 30 minutes, then asks.

post.summary: Say a showing read from a ShowingTime email is right, correcting its time or agent if it was read wrong.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits .

post.summary: Record what a buyer’s agent said about a showing (their buyers’ interest, what they liked, what gave them pause, how the price felt), when they said it by phone or text.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.showing.feedback_received. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Share a showing’s feedback with the seller in their portal, as it was given.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.showing.feedback_shared.

post.summary: Add a vendor to the business’s directory, or change one: the company (one in Contacts, or a new one), what they do, where, and any disclosure the client must be told of (an affiliation, a referral fee). A new vendor waits for approval.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.vendor.saved, company.created. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Approve a vendor for the business’s deals, or take the approval back. Only approved vendors are offered on a duty.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.manage. Emits realestate.vendor.saved.

post.summary: Take a vendor out of the directory: they’re no longer offered on a duty. The duties they were picked on keep them, as they were.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.manage. Emits realestate.vendor.saved.

post.summary: Pick an approved vendor on a duty (the inspector on “Schedule inspections”, say). Their disclosure is said on the deal; their quote and appointment can be added after.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.duty.vendor_picked.

post.summary: Keep a picked vendor’s quote on the duty: the amount, and the quote itself as one of the deal’s documents.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits .

post.summary: Say which appointment on the calendar is a picked vendor’s for the duty, or none.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits .

post.summary: Take a vendor off a duty, with the reason. What was kept on it stays, marked.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits .

post.summary: Turn a buyer’s saved search on the business’s listing feed on or off. On, their profile is asked every fifteen minutes and new homes come to the agent.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.search.changed.

post.summary: Send a buyer’s new match to the client: it becomes one of the deal’s homes, with what the MLS says of it, and the client sees it in their portal with the MLS’s notice.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.match.sent, realestate.home.added. Can wait on a phone for 30 minutes, then asks.

post.summary: Set aside one of a buyer’s new matches: the client never sees it, and it doesn’t come back.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.match.dismissed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Note something in the field on a deal: typed, a recording or photos, about the deal, a home, a tour stop, a showing, an open house or the walkthrough. A recording’s words follow on their own.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.field_note.added, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Plan a deal’s final walkthrough: its checklist from the repairs agreed, what the contract says stays and goes, the inspection’s serious findings and each room.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.walkthrough.changed, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn.

post.summary: Start a planned walkthrough, at the home.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.walkthrough.changed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Mark one thing on a walkthrough OK, not OK or not sure, with a note and photos; or uncheck it.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.walkthrough.changed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Add something to check on a walkthrough that its list doesn’t have.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.walkthrough.changed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Finish a walkthrough: each thing that isn’t right becomes a duty before closing, and your word that it’s done counts for the walkthrough’s duty.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits realestate.walkthrough.finished, realestate.duty.added, realestate.duty.evidence_added, realestate.duty.evidence_withdrawn. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Export the whole transaction: every file on the deal with its fingerprint, and every record, in one zip with a manifest. It’s kept on the deal’s Documents when it’s ready.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.export. Emits realestate.deal.export_requested.

post.summary: A listing’s lockbox: its kind, where it is, its serial, and its code (sealed on the way, never shown back here).
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits .

post.summary: Takes a lockbox off a listing, and its code with it.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires realestate.use. Emits .

post.summary: Write a playbook for social outreach, or change one: its name, goal and offer, who it’s for, where to look, the steps it takes, how it sounds and the tags to use.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.manage. Emits outreach.playbook.saved.

post.summary: Put a playbook away, or bring an archived one back.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.manage. Emits outreach.playbook.archived.

post.summary: Save someone’s social profile as the extension read it: finds the customer it’s saved to, or the one picked, or adds them, and keeps their intro and where the two of you stand.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.profile.saved.
