post.summary: Save a chat as the extension read it: finds or adds the customer it’s with from the profile it links to, and adds the messages it hadn’t saved before, keeping the most recent.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.chat.saved, outreach.profile.saved.

post.summary: Save to their card: copy a chat brought in from Messenger or Facebook’s file onto the customer’s Social card, adding the messages it hadn’t saved before. Finds the customer from the chat or its profile, or takes the one picked, or adds them when asked.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.chat.saved, outreach.profile.saved.

post.summary: Note a step the person took on a social network themselves, as the extension saw it: a friend request, a like, a comment or a message, to whom and from which group. Adds nobody to Contacts.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.touch.saved. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Note the person answering a friend request on a social network themselves, as the extension saw it: Confirm makes them friends, and Delete turns the request down. Adds nobody to Contacts.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.friend.answered. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Save a list the extension read off a social network, as far as the page had loaded: the person’s friends, the friend requests they’ve got, or the ones they’ve sent. Adds nobody to Contacts.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.friends.saved.

post.summary: Keep a friend (never suggested for unfriending), or put someone on the business’s Don’t pitch list (never a friend request, like, comment or message) or take them off it.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.friend.marked.

post.summary: Bring in a part of the person’s Facebook download file as their browser read it: the names in their friends, requests, removed friends, deleted requests, followers and following, with when, and when they last messaged each person with their latest few messages, which the AI reads later. The last part matches the names to the profiles saved here and puts it in place in their own friends. Adds nobody to Contacts itself.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.download.saved.

post.summary: Bring in one-to-one chats the extension read in Messenger in the person’s browser, each with its latest few messages and when they were sent, for the AI to read later. They join the chats from the person’s Facebook download, one per person. Adds nobody to Contacts itself.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.chats.collected.

post.summary: Save the groups on a Facebook page the person has open (their own groups, or search results), with what the page says about each: public or private, how many members, the line under its name, and whether they are in it. Nothing goes in Contacts.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.groups.saved.

post.summary: Save a Facebook group the person has open and the people on its People tab (or one of its See all pages), with the lines under each name. Admins and moderators are kept as such and never suggested; the full list of them marks the group’s admins as read. Nobody goes in Contacts.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.group.saved.

post.summary: Note a sent friend request the extension cancelled, or a friend it unfriended, on a social network for the person, once they ticked them: they’re no longer friends or asked, and it counts against today’s limit. One done already when the extension got there is noted but not counted.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.friend.ended. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Note a warning Facebook showed the person, in its own words, as the extension read it: it halves their daily limits for a week, keeps friend requests off their list for two days, stops the extension for them for the day on every computer, and tells their phone.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.warning.seen. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Keep the posts in a Facebook group’s feed that are worth a comment from the person: those saying a playbook’s signs or asking for help, with who wrote them, for the AI to check. Says how each post the page shows stands, for the extension to mark. Nobody goes in Contacts.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.posts.saved.

post.summary: Put a group post aside: it comes off the person’s list for today and isn’t suggested again.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.post.skipped. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: The extension saw chats on the person’s Facebook whose last message is theirs: each one after a message of the person’s it noted is kept as a reply, once, and their phone told unless they were looking at it.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.reply.seen.

post.summary: The person copied a first message to someone: note which of the playbook’s openers it was drafted with, for the results card. Once a first message to them is noted, the opener stays the one it was.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.opener.used.

post.summary: The person says someone they reached booked a demo some other way than the demo link, or takes that back. It counts toward which openers work.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.demo.marked.

post.summary: The person chooses what the browser extension does for them on Facebook on its own (friend requests, likes and comments, messages, replies, liking a post first, confirming requests that fit, the once-a-day jobs), its switches, how their phone hears what waits, and their working hours; an owner or admin can choose for anyone. Only what the business allows.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.automation.saved.

post.summary: The extension found no post to like on someone’s profile before their friend request: the request goes without it.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.warm_up.missed.

post.summary: An owner or admin ends someone’s training wheels early: their messages go without waiting for them, and their daily limits are full again.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.manage. Emits outreach.wheels.ended.

post.summary: The extension drafted a message to someone on the person’s list for today: a first message, a follow-up or a reply. It waits for the person’s OK, or, when they chose for messages to go on their own and their training wheels are off, goes as it is. A message already drafted for them comes back instead.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.send.queued.

post.summary: The person OKs messages the extension drafted, as they are or changed; with none named, every one waiting (Approve all) except replies handed over to them and messages to someone who needs them, which wait to be OK’d one at a time. The extension sends them. On training wheels, each counts toward coming off them.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.send.approved. Can wait on a phone for 30 minutes, then asks.

post.summary: The person skips a message the extension drafted: it isn’t sent, and the person is off their list for today.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.send.skipped. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: The extension sent an OK’d message in Messenger, or couldn’t, and why. The message itself is noted as a step, as any other. One that couldn’t go waits for the person in Waiting for you, with its words, to send themselves.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.send.done, outreach.need.noted.

post.summary: The browser extension says it’s there, on one of the person’s computers: what it’s doing now, its next step and the steps it took since. Answers whether this computer is the one that works, and the person’s day.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.live.changed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Start my day: the extension on the person’s computer that works starts on their list for today now, at a person’s pace, working hours or not. Pressed on the web, the phone or in the extension.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.day.started, outreach.live.changed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Stop for today: the extension on the person’s computers does nothing more on its own until their next working hours. Pressed on the web, the phone or in the extension.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.day.stopped, outreach.live.changed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: The person renames one of their own computers the extension runs on.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.computer.renamed.

post.summary: The browser extension couldn’t do a step on the person’s list for today on Facebook (a button or box it couldn’t find, a different page, Facebook not taking it): it’s handed to the person in Waiting for you, to do themselves or let go. The same step again is the same one; one let go lately keeps nothing.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.need.noted. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: The person did a step the extension handed to them, or let it go: it leaves Waiting for you. Let go, the same step for the same person isn’t handed over again for a week.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.need.cleared. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: The person leaves a friend request they got as it is: it leaves Waiting for you until the same person asks again. Nothing changes on Facebook.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.request.set_aside. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: The person asks their computer, from HandsFreeOS, to do something on Facebook only the browser extension can: get their Facebook file, check their friend requests, save their friends, groups or a group’s members, find posts, read their chats, cancel or unfriend the people they ticked, or look someone up before drafting. The computer that works for them takes it. Asking again while one like it is open answers that one.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.ask.made.

post.summary: The browser extension on the person’s computer that works takes the oldest thing they asked of it from HandsFreeOS. A computer standing by takes nothing. On a day Facebook warned them, asks that would open Facebook end instead.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.ask.started, outreach.ask.ended.

post.summary: The browser extension says how an ask is going: its line, and whether it needs the person (a step it can’t find, or their password). Answers whether the person stopped it, and their answer to a step handed to them.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.ask.progressed.

post.summary: The browser extension says how an ask ended: done, or why it didn’t finish, with a look-up’s drafts. One the person stopped stays stopped.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.ask.ended. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: The person answers a step their computer handed to them: Carry on (they did it, or it should look again), or Skip (that person).
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.ask.replied.

post.summary: The person stops something they asked of their computer: one waiting never starts, and one under way stops at its next page.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.ask.cancelled.

post.summary: Add to Contacts: someone the person reached, kept as a profile, becomes a customer in Contacts with Facebook as their source, or is tied to the customer the person says they are.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.profile.saved.

post.summary: The person finished a step of the Social Outreach setup (it never moves back), finished it, left it for later, hid its reminder, or the extension said it’s signed in.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.setup.saved.

post.summary: What someone the person knows on Facebook says on their profile and business page, as the person’s computer just read it, for the AI to see whether they fit a playbook; or that Facebook showed someone else. Kept only until the AI has read it.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.check.looked.

post.summary: Say where someone the person reached stands, when they know better than what’s worked out: ready to pitch (Today offers Pitch), pitched, not a fit (nothing on Today reaches them again but a reply), or back in play.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.stage.marked.

post.summary: What a Facebook group’s About page, rules and latest posts said as the person’s computer read them, for the AI to see whether the playbooks’ people are there. The About page and rules are kept on the group; the posts only until the AI has read them.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.group.looked.

post.summary: How the person’s computer’s ask to join a Facebook group went: asked, waiting for the admins, joined, or couldn’t and why, with the AI’s answers to the group’s questions. Joined, it’s one of the person’s groups.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.join.noted.

post.summary: Ask the AI for today’s helpful post: one that helps the people in one of the person’s groups that fits (theirs to name, else the best not posted in this week), from the playbook and what people there ask, after reading its rules. One a day; asking again answers today’s.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.helpful.asked.

post.summary: OK a helpful post for the person’s computer to put up in its group, as written or as they changed it. Their computer posts it when asked (an ask of kind post).
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.helpful.oked.

post.summary: Put a helpful post aside: it isn’t posted. The day’s slot is free for another.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.helpful.skipped.

post.summary: A helpful post went up in its group (the extension posted it, or the person says they did), with its link once known; or the extension couldn’t post it, with why.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.helpful.posted.

post.summary: Who reacted to or commented on one of the person’s helpful posts, as the extension read it: each kept as a profile from the group, a warm lead for Today. Nobody goes in Contacts.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires outreach.use. Emits outreach.helpful.engaged.

post.summary: The migrations this organization has run or is running, and the sources it has connected.
post.description: Any signed-in user.

post.summary: Everything one migration knows about itself: where each business lands, what was found, what was chosen, what will not fit, what is left to do, and how far it has got.
post.description: Any signed-in user.

post.summary: The customers a migration is not sure about: somebody arriving who might be somebody already here.
post.description: Any signed-in user.

post.summary: What taking this migration back would do: what goes, what is put back, and what is left alone because somebody has changed it here since.
post.description: Any signed-in user.

post.summary: The completion report: what came across, what was checked, what will not fit, and what is left for a person to do.
post.description: Any signed-in user.

post.summary: Whether a customer is in the portal: when and by whom they were let in, when they last used it, and the devices signed in now.
post.description: Requires records.read.

post.summary: The support queue, newest activity first.
post.description: Requires support.read.

post.summary: One ticket: the whole conversation, what happened to it, and who it is from.
post.description: Requires support.read.

post.summary: The numbers at the top of the support desk.
post.description: Requires support.read.

post.summary: The saved replies everyone answering support can use.
post.description: Requires support.read.

post.summary: Who answers HandsFreeOS support, and who has been invited.
post.description: Requires support.read.

post.summary: Whether the signed-in person answers HandsFreeOS support, and what they may do.
post.description: Any signed-in user.

post.summary: Every business on HandsFreeOS: when they signed up, who is in them, how busy they are.
post.description: Requires platform.businesses.read.

post.summary: One business: its people, how much of each thing it holds, and what it has set up.
post.description: Requires platform.businesses.read.

post.summary: What has failed lately across every business, so it is found before a customer writes in.
post.description: Requires platform.health.read.

post.summary: Which AI is answering, Claude or OpenAI, why, and what Claude’s status page last said.
post.description: Requires platform.health.read.

post.summary: The business this person is looking at, if any. Answers for everyone, staff or not.
post.description: Any signed-in user.

post.summary: The live usage rate card, and what each line actually charged against what it actually cost over a period.
post.description: Requires platform.rates.manage.

post.summary: One business’s usage balance, its card, and what 30 days of it cost against what it was charged.
post.description: Requires platform.businesses.read.

post.summary: The view you have open in a business, while it still holds; null when there is none, it has ended, or you may no longer view as that person.
post.description: Any signed-in user.

post.summary: Through a view: the teammate’s role and permissions, and the threads, Action Center items and bills they see where that is fewer than the whole business. The phone shows its copy through it.
post.description: Requires workspace.read.
